actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Donald Trump dominates right-wing news coverage following historic Republican losses in the 2026 midterm elections, which handed control of Congress to Democrats. Media analysis and political figures across the U.S. and Europe cite public backlash over his administration's war in Iran and economic inflation as the primary drivers of the defeat, sparking intense debates over the future of the MAGA movement.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: President Javier Milei generated wide international coverage during his visit to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit, where he delivered a provocative speech equating socialism with fascism directly before Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. In addition to high-profile summit clashes, Milei held exclusive meetings with Vox leader Santiago Abascal while dealing with internal political rift between Karina Milei and Security Minister Patricia Bullrich.

actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro remains a central subject of intense media scrutiny after leaving Brazil for the United States, telling reporters he would 'take to the grave' how he exited the country amid legal investigations. His upcoming appearance at a CPAC gala at Mar-a-Lago has drawn sharp reactions, including calls from U.S. lawmakers for his immediate deportation and debates in the Brazilian Senate regarding his mandate.

actors.name: Jordan Bardella
actors.blurb: Jordan Bardella is driving French political coverage following the Assembly's rejection of the 2027 budget, calling for an urgent constitutional 'golden rule' on debt reduction while promoting his new book Gouverner. His media appearances and proposals regarding retirement quarters and opposition to minimum wage hikes have drawn sharp counterattacks from right-wing rivals such as Bruno Retailleau.

actors.name: Santiago Abascal
actors.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal is featuring heavily in Spanish political news as he launches pre-campaign efforts in Teruel and Granada ahead of regional elections. Coverage is further heightened by his high-profile bilateral meeting in Madrid with Argentine President Javier Milei, an upcoming interview on TVE's La Revuelta, and an egg-throwing incident targeted at him during a rally in Ciudad Real.
